definitions.supplemental: The second passage in Dict., and all but the first here refer to the same incident. [v. N. E. D. ridder. O. H. Ger. rít(e)ra cribrum.]

quotations.old_english: Hú hé geedstaðelode, þ-bar; tóbrokene hridder (capisterium) . . . hé genam þá sticcu þæs tóbrocenan hriddres (hridderes, v. l.) . . . and hire ágæf þ-bar; hriddern (hridder, v. l.) . . . þá landleóde áhéngon þ-bar; ilce hriddern (hridder) in þǽre cyrcan ingange

source_text: hridder. Add: , hríder, hriddern:--Hríder glebulum, Wrt. Voc. ii. 98, 12. Hridder capisterium, 92, 3: 19, 38. Hú hé geedstaðelode, þ-bar; tóbrokene hridder (capisterium) . . . hé genam þá sticcu þæs tóbrocenan hriddres (hridderes, v. l.) . . . and hire ágæf þ-bar; hriddern (hridder, v. l.) . . . þá landleóde áhéngon þ-bar; ilce hriddern (hridder) in þǽre cyrcan ingange, Gr. D. 96, 30-97, 34. [The second passage in Dict., and all but the first here refer to the same incident.] [v. N. E. D. ridder. O. H. Ger. rít(e)ra cribrum.]
